packs.title: Borders on old maps
packs.summary: Europe on eight dated maps, drawn on the globe. Tap a country and drag the date: the map changes, and the last map's outline stays, dashed.

packs.title: A gathering of water
packs.summary: The rivers of South America on the globe: touch one to follow its water to the coast and see the tributaries that gather into it.

packs.title: A gathering of water, alive
packs.summary: South America's rivers with the water running: touch one, or rest a finger and draw across many, and the light runs to the sea together.

packs.title: Delivery check
packs.summary: A test pack: which revision arrived, and from where. Tap the sea for a ring.

packs.title: The herds
packs.summary: The camel family's history as small herds you follow across the globe: from North America, camels north to Asia, llamas south to the Andes.

packs.title: The sea between
packs.summary: An engraved chart of the Aegean lying on the globe: sound the sea between the islands, and read its notes on the wind, a caldera, a palm and the deep.

packs.title: Sounding the deep
packs.summary: HMS Challenger exploring the deep ocean, 1873–76, station by station on the globe. Touch a station to lower the line to the recorded depth.
